scope: one fixed 72-tetrahedron twisted complex, integral Morse reverse map P
method: For each nonzero P[k][output_cell,input_simplex], take the minimum ordinary quotient 1-skeleton graph distance between any barycentric vertex of the input simplex and any barycentric vertex occurring in the integral forward subdivision S of the output CW cell. This is a weak minimum-distance diagnostic, not a full support-containment radius.
